inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: Infant was sleeping with a pacifier containing a string attached to their clothing.     Note: The string removed from the infants clothing during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Children under two were observed watching television during the inspection.     Note: Caregivers turned the television off during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: The operation combined a 6 month old infant with older children during the inspection. The oldest child in the group was 5 years old.  The oldest child can be no older than 23 months old.    Note: Caregivers transitioned children to their assigned classrooms during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the inspection the child to caregiver ratio was 11 children to 1 caregiver. The specified age group was 18-23 months and the maximum number of children allowed with this group should've been 9.    Note: An additional caregiver was added to the group once they arrived.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: Expired milk was served to children for breakfast during the inspection.    Note: The provider purchased and provided new milk during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: A caregiver with provisional eligibility was observed in a classroom alone with children. The conditions of the caregivers background check were not followed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: The feeding instructions for 1 infant was last signed and dated by the parent on 3/7/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: 10 employee records were evaluated and were missing the following information:    Proof of Background Check Eligibility Letter  Signed and Updated Personnel and Operation Policies from staff  Notarized Employment Affidavit Forms  Dates of Employment  Completion of Orientation
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies provided for review did not contain the following information: A Safe Sleeping Policy for Infants under 12 Months The criteria the operation will use to determine when extreme weather conditions pose a significant health risk to children Information on vaccine-preventable diseases for employees Required annual trainings for employees in preventing and responding to abuse and neglect of children Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of issues regarding child abuse and neglect, including warning signs that a child may be a victim of abuse or neglect and factors indicating a child is at risk for abuse or neglect Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of prevention techniques for child abuse and neglect Strategies for coordination between the center and appropriate community organizations  Actions that the parent of a child who is a victim of abuse or neglect should take to obtain assistance and intervention, including procedures for reporting child abuse or neglect.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Medication Records - Name of Medication: The medication log was missing the name of medication that was administered to a child in care. The name of medication was listed as pain medication.    Note: The provider found the medication that was given and documented it on the medication log during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Records - Name of Medication (26 TAC §746.3805(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: A caregiver did not have information available to them in the classroom showing all of the children's ages who were in care during the inspection.     Note: The provider updated the children's ages during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Children's admissions information was evaluated and missing the following documentation:    Dates of Admission  Incomplete Health Statements  Incomplete Emegency Contact Information  Incomplete Signature for the Receipt of Operational Policies  Missing Special Needs Statements  Missing Signatures on the Authorization for Emergency Medical Transporation and Treatment
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: Children did not wash their hands before eating their snack during the follow up inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of caregivers-Set appropriate behavior expectations: Children were observed fighting one another during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: Emergency phone #'s were missing for 2 children who were transported.    Note: One child's emergency phone # was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The child safety alarm in the white van is not functioning properly. When the driver pressed the button to turn the alarm off it continued going off after testing multiple times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: The first aid kit in the van was missing gauze and antiseptics solution.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: During the follow up inspection, 5 infants were left unsupervised and there was no caregiver present in the room.    Note: A caregiver returned to the classroom during the inspection. Discussed with the provider that infants are never to be left alone and another staff must step in when the caregiver needs to leave the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The emergency preparedness plan does not address the designated sheltering/lock-down location within the center where children should gather.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A food allergy emergency plan was not available for review for a child with a food allergy to peanuts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The maintenance checklists do not document broken equipment observed on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Lysol spray was observed on a low shelf in reach of children during the inspection.    Note: The provider removed the cleaning supplies from the shelf during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment: The use zone for stationary equipment did not meet the 6 feet requirement.    Note: The provider arranged the equipment during the inspection so that it meets 6 feet on all sides.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §746.4803)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: Observed a broken fence on the outdoor play area with nails that are exposed and accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver did not know the correct number of children they were responsible for during the inspection. The caregiver stated there were 14 children when only 13 children were accounted for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: Smoke and Carbon Monoxide detectors were not tested in February of 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The daily menu showed pineapples were to be served for lunch when children were served fruit cocktail.     Note: The provided noted the substitution on the menu during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions (26 TAC §746.3313(1))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Fire drills were not conducted in February of 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting): The use zone for rotating and bouncing equipment on the playground does not extend 6 feet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting) (26 TAC §746.4813(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the follow up inspection, toilet seats were broken and observed broken toilet roll despenser.The tiles in the restroom used by school age children are in need of repair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Observed a bottle of Clorox and Draino in an unlocked cabinet in the 4's and 5's room during the follow up inspection.     Note: The provider removed the cleaning supplies during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: During the follow up inspection, children's records were still missing special care needs statements and complete emergency contact information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: During the follow up inspection, a screw was observed under the play structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Waterproof, Washable Mattress: Sheets in a crib in the infant room were not snug fitting and had to be tied to fit to the mattress.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Waterproof, Washable Mattress (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: The van used to transport chidren is not equipped with a child safety alarm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Medication Records - Date, Time and Amount Given: The medication log was missing dates and amounts of medication given to children on various dates,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Records - Date, Time and Amount Given (26 TAC §746.3805(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: 1 out of 5 staff files is in need of skill based CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A physician's statement was missing on a food allergy emergency plan for a child with a known food allergy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Children's records for 5 children in care did not contain the following information:    3 were missing consent for field trips, transportation and water activities.    1 was missing signature from the parent authorization for emergency medical treatment.    1 was missing the school name and phone #.    1 was missing an immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play: Water was not made readily available to children during lunch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play (26 TAC §746.3301(f)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The last Children's Product Certification has not been completed since December 12th, 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: Observed several nails, screws and washers in the outdoor play area that pose a safety hazard to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired: Expired alcohol wipes were observed in the first aid kit,
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired (26 TAC §746.4003(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: An infants crib was not labeled with their name during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Special Diets - No Nutrient Concentrates or Supplements: Observed a bottle in the infant room filled with a brown protein mixture. Documentation of written consent from a health care professional or dietician was not available upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Special Diets - No Nutrient Concentrates or Supplements (26 TAC §746.3311(d))

occurrences.finding: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: A lightbulb was out in the toddler room restroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §746.3407(10))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked: A fenced in area to the outdoor play area cannot be properly opened by each caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked (26 TAC §746.4309)

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Scissors: There were no scissors in the first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Scissors (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Poisonous/Toxic Materials Stored Separate from Food: Observed a box of disinfectant spray stored in the pantry where the food is located.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Poisonous/Toxic Materials Stored Separate from Food (26 TAC §746.3317(10))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was observed in the 4 & 5 year old classroom with direct access to children. The provider has not received an eligiblity determination from CBCU stating they can be present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Observed two broken tissue roll holders in the 3 &4's classroom.     The deck in the outdoor play area contains uneven surfaces that pose a tripping hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: Observed expired medication during the inspection that has not been disposed.    Note: The provider put the expired medication in the trash can during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: A fire inspection has not been conducted since December 15th, 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Share Indoor Activity Space With Written Plan: The operation is sharing space with another program. A written plan of shared space was not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Share Indoor Activity Space With Written Plan (26 TAC §746.4215(a))

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System Tested: Documentation showing the current annual smoke detection system testing was not available for review upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System Tested (26 TAC §746.5315)
